n-hier.text:
HIERARCHY
Home is one page with three phases, not three cards. The date is the title; the sheet holds Writing Prompt + Student Writing and stays put through all phases. In review the sheet moves left and keeps the marked-up text on screen while Corrections arrive on the right (under it on mobile). CEFR is a header chip; Placement Test only appears on first run.

n-focus.text:
FOCUS PLACEMENT
Focus sits directly above the sheet, before the prompt exists and after. It is one line of plain text (1–2 Weaknesses), so the learner reads why this prompt was chosen before reading the prompt. In review, Mistakes that match today's Focus carry a small "focus du jour" tag, and the closing CTA links that Weakness to the Carnet.

n-scores.text:
WHY SCORES ARE DEMOTED
A score says how it went; a Correction says what to change. Corrections come first and carry the actions that feed memory (Mistake counts, Dialect Notes). Overall CEFR + four dimensions fold into one line, "Scores ▸", under the Corrections. Tweak "scoresOpen" on the review artboard shows it expanded. Dimension names are placeholders: swap in the app's real four.

n-kinds.text:
THREE KINDS, THREE SIGNALS
Each kind differs by color, underline style and marker shape, so none relies on hue alone. Mistake: rust, solid underline, filled round marker. Français standard: blue, dashed underline, outlined marker, never a fill. Dialect check: ochre, wavy underline, question marker.
Motion (3 moments): prompt fades up on generate; marks paint left-to-right when the Evaluation lands; the Dialect Note sheet slides up.
